verses.text_urhobo: Asakiephana owẹvwe de rhi fi vwẹ otọ na, rọ rho nọ owẹvwe ro firi vwẹ ọke rẹ Ebraham. Aizik de kpo Gẹra, bru Abimẹlẹk ovie ri Filistia.
verses.text_romanized: asakiephana owevwe de rhi fi vwe oto na ro rho no owevwe ro firi vwe oke re ebraham aizik de kpo gera bru abimelek ovie ri filistia

verses.text_urhobo: Orvwohwo da vwẹ oma phia kẹ, ọ da ta, Wo kpo Ijipti-i; dia otọ re Me ta kẹ wẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: orvwohwo da vwe oma phia ke o da ta wo kpo ijipti i dia oto re me ta ke we na

verses.text_urhobo: Dia ukane wẹn vwe otọ nana, ki mi nene uwe dia, ki mi bruba kẹ wẹ; kidie vwọ kẹ wẹ vẹ uvwiẹ wẹn Me cha vwẹ etọ nana kẹ, ki mi ru ive ri mi veri kẹ Ebraham rẹ ọsẹ wẹn gba.
verses.text_romanized: dia ukane wen vwe oto nana ki mi nene uwe dia ki mi bruba ke we kidie vwo ke we ve uvwie wen me cha vwe eto nana ke ki mi ru ive ri mi veri ke ebraham re ose wen gba

verses.text_urhobo: Ki mi ru uvwiẹ wẹn bu kiri isio ri obenu, ke Me vwẹ etọ nana ejobi na vwọ kẹ uvwiẹ wẹn; vwẹ oma rẹ uvwiẹ wẹn ọye ẹgborho rẹ akpọ na ejobi de vwo ebruphihọ kẹ oma rayen:
verses.text_romanized: ki mi ru uvwie wen bu kiri isio ri obenu ke me vwe eto nana ejobi na vwo ke uvwie wen vwe oma re uvwie wen oye egborho re akpo na ejobi de vwo ebruphiho ke oma rayen

verses.text_urhobo: fikiridie Ebraham mu ọghọ kẹ urhuru mẹ, iji mẹ, kugbe ẹgha mẹ, kugbe irhi Me.
verses.text_romanized: fikiridie ebraham mu ogho ke urhuru me iji me kugbe egha me kugbe irhi me

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Aizik da dia Gẹra.
verses.text_romanized: koye aizik da dia gera

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ihwo rẹ asan na vwọ nọ ekpẹn rẹ aye rọye, ọ da ta, Oniọvo mẹ oruẹ; kidie oshọ muro rọ vwọ ta nẹ, Aye mẹ, ko roro nẹ ihwo rẹ asan na che hwe ọye fiki ri Rebeka, kidie oyovwiri gangan.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ihwo re asan na vwo no ekpen re aye roye o da ta oniovo me orue kidie osho muro ro vwo ta ne aye me ko roro ne ihwo re asan na che hwe oye fiki ri rebeka kidie oyovwiri gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Rọ vwọ dia Etiyin krekri re, Abimẹlẹk ovie ri Filistia vwo nẹ evakpo ọ da mrẹ Aizik rọ vẹ Rebeka bẹnẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ro vwo dia etiyin krekri re abimelek ovie ri filistia vwo ne evakpo o da mre aizik ro ve rebeka bene

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Abimẹlẹk de se Aizik, ọ da ta, Nighe, aye wẹn oruẹ, komavọ wọ rha vwọ tanẹ oniọvo mẹ? Aizik da ta kẹ, Kidie mi rori nẹ, e che hwe vwe fiki rọye.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin abimelek de se aizik o da ta nighe aye wen orue komavo wo rha vwo tane oniovo me aizik da ta ke kidie mi rori ne e che hwe vwe fiki roye

verses.text_urhobo: Abimẹlẹk da ta, Ọna didi emu wo ru avwanre na? Ọ dianẹ kẹ ọvo vwẹ usu rẹ avwanre na vwẹ oma te, yọ nẹrhẹ avwanre riabe.
verses.text_romanized: abimelek da ta ona didi emu wo ru avwanre na o diane ke ovo vwe usu re avwanre na vwe oma te yo nerhe avwanre riabe

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Abimẹlẹk da kpa okpa kẹ ihwo rọye, tanẹ, Kohwo kohwo rọ vwẹ obo te aye rọye ko ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: koye abimelek da kpa okpa ke ihwo roye tane kohwo kohwo ro vwe obo te aye roye ko ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Aizik de voro udju ukpe yena vwẹ otọ na, o de vun ujori. Ọrovwohwo de bruphihọ kẹ,
verses.text_romanized: aizik de voro udju ukpe yena vwe oto na o de vun ujori orovwohwo de bruphiho ke

verses.text_urhobo: ohwo na de rhi fe, efe na kẹ ebuebuo bẹsiẹ rọ ke rhe dia ọdafe rode.
verses.text_romanized: ohwo na de rhi fe efe na ke ebuebuo besie ro ke rhe dia odafe rode

verses.text_urhobo: O de vwo uchuru vẹ eranvwe buebu, kugbe ikru, ihwo ri Filistia na ke rioma kpahọ.
verses.text_romanized: o de vwo uchuru ve eranvwe buebu kugbe ikru ihwo ri filistia na ke rioma kpaho

verses.text_urhobo: (Vwẹ ọke nana ihwo ri Filistia de gbe erhare ejobi rẹ idibo rẹ ọsẹ rọye tọnre vwẹ ọke rẹ Ebraham ọsẹ rọye.)
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke nana ihwo ri filistia de gbe erhare ejobi re idibo re ose roye tonre vwe oke re ebraham ose roye

verses.text_urhobo: Abimẹlẹk da ta kẹ Aizik, Kpo nẹ orho rẹ avwanre, kidie wọ goma nọ avwanre.
verses.text_romanized: abimelek da ta ke aizik kpo ne orho re avwanre kidie wo goma no avwanre

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Aizik de vrẹn nẹ Etiyin, o de mu erhọn phihọ ushekpotọ ri Gẹra kẹ Etiyin ọ diare.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin aizik de vren ne etiyin o de mu erhon phiho ushekpoto ri gera ke etiyin o diare

verses.text_urhobo: Aizik da rhoma tọn erhare ra tọnre vwẹ ọke rẹ Ebraham ọsẹ rọye, fikiridie ihwo ri Filistia gbe ayen vwẹ ọke rẹ Ebraham vwo ghwu nu, o de mu edẹ rẹ ọsẹ rọye mu kẹ ayen jovwo na kẹ ayen.
verses.text_romanized: aizik da rhoma ton erhare ra tonre vwe oke re ebraham ose roye fikiridie ihwo ri filistia gbe ayen vwe oke re ebraham vwo ghwu nu o de mu ede re ose roye mu ke ayen jovwo na ke ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọke rẹ idibo rẹ Aizik vwọ tọn ushekpotọ na ayen da mrẹ orhare rẹ ogbugbu rẹ ame,
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oke re idibo re aizik vwo ton ushekpoto na ayen da mre orhare re ogbugbu re ame

verses.text_urhobo: isuigodẹ rẹ ihwo ri Gẹra vẹ erẹ Aizik ke ghwọ, tanẹ, Ame na ọ rẹ avwanre. Kọye o de se odẹ rẹ orhare na Esek, kidie ayen ghwọ gbe.
verses.text_romanized: isuigode re ihwo ri gera ve ere aizik ke ghwo tane ame na o re avwanre koye o de se ode re orhare na esek kidie ayen ghwo gbe

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da tọn ọfa ayen da je ghwọ gbe; Etiyin o de se odẹ Sitnah.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da ton ofa ayen da je ghwo gbe etiyin o de se ode sitnah

verses.text_urhobo: O de vrẹn nẹ Etiyin ọ da ra tọn orhare ọfa, ayen gbe ghwọ vwẹ ọyena-a, Etiyin o de se odẹ rọye Rehobọth, tanẹ, Fikiridie Ọrovwohwo kẹ avwanre asan dia, otọ na ko yovwi kẹ avwanre.
verses.text_romanized: o de vren ne etiyin o da ra ton orhare ofa ayen gbe ghwo vwe oyena a etiyin o de se ode roye rehoboth tane fikiridie orovwohwo ke avwanre asan dia oto na ko yovwi ke avwanre

verses.text_urhobo: O vrẹn nẹ Etiyin ọ da yan kpo Bẹẹrsheba.
verses.text_romanized: o vren ne etiyin o da yan kpo beersheba

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo da vwẹ oma phia kẹ vwẹ ason yena ọ da ta, Mẹvwẹ Ọghẹnẹ rẹ Ebraham rẹ ọsẹ wẹn, wọ djoshọ-ọ, kidie Me vẹ owẹ herọ ki mi bruphihọ kẹ wẹ uvwiẹ wẹn ko bu phihọ fiki rẹ odibo mẹ Ebraham.
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo da vwe oma phia ke vwe ason yena o da ta mevwe oghene re ebraham re ose wen wo djosho o kidie me ve owe hero ki mi bruphiho ke we uvwie wen ko bu phiho fiki re odibo me ebraham

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ọ da so agbada o de se odẹ rẹ Ọrovwohwo, ọ da ghwa fa ọko phihọ Etiyin. Idibo rẹ Aizik da tọn orhare vwọ asan na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin o da so agbada o de se ode re orovwohwo o da ghwa fa oko phiho etiyin idibo re aizik da ton orhare vwo asan na

verses.text_urhobo: Abimẹlẹk da yan ni Gẹra bro ra ọ vẹ Ahuzath re ọbuiroro rọye kugbe Fikol rẹ onotu rẹ ofovwi rọye.
verses.text_romanized: abimelek da yan ni gera bro ra o ve ahuzath re obuiroro roye kugbe fikol re onotu re ofovwi roye

verses.text_urhobo: Aizik da ta kẹ, Die wo rhe vwo bru rhire, yẹ ivun mẹ vwerha owẹ-ẹ, wọ ke rha djẹ vwẹ nẹ oma?
verses.text_romanized: aizik da ta ke die wo rhe vwo bru rhire ye ivun me vwerha owe e wo ke rha dje vwe ne oma

verses.text_urhobo: Ayen da ta, Avwanre mrẹre phẹphẹ nẹ Ọrovwohwo vẹ owẹ herọ, kọye avwanre vwọ tanẹ, e jẹ avwanre duvwu iyori kẹ oma, rere avwanre vẹ owẹ re ọphọ,
verses.text_romanized: ayen da ta avwanre mrere phephe ne orovwohwo ve owe hero koye avwanre vwo tane e je avwanre duvwu iyori ke oma rere avwanre ve owe re opho

verses.text_urhobo: nẹ wo kpokpo avwanre-e, kirobo rẹ avwanre vwẹ obọ te we-e, Me ji ru we emuọvo-o jokpa rẹ uyoyovwi avwanre ki rhe siobọ nẹ uwe kpo egberhẹnẹdẹ. Asakiephana wẹ kẹ ohwo rẹ Ọrovwohwo bruphihọ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ne wo kpokpo avwanre e kirobo re avwanre vwe obo te we e me ji ru we emuovo o jokpa re uyoyovwi avwanre ki rhe siobo ne uwe kpo egberhenede asakiephana we ke ohwo re orovwohwo bruphiho ke

verses.text_urhobo: O de chere emu kẹ ayen, ayen da re ayen da da.
verses.text_romanized: o de chere emu ke ayen ayen da re ayen da da

verses.text_urhobo: Irhiọke ride ayen de vrẹn ayen da re ọphọ; Aizik de siobọ nẹ ayen, ayen de kpo egberhẹnẹdẹ.
verses.text_romanized: irhioke ride ayen de vren ayen da re opho aizik de siobo ne ayen ayen de kpo egberhenede

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹdẹ yena vuọvo na idibo rẹ Aizik da rhe vuẹ kpahe orhare rẹ ayen tọnre, ayen da ta ke, Avwanre mrẹ ame re.
verses.text_romanized: ede yena vuovo na idibo re aizik da rhe vue kpahe orhare re ayen tonre ayen da ta ke avwanre mre ame re

verses.text_urhobo: O de se Shibah, fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e de se odẹ rẹ orere na Bẹẹrsheba rhi te nonẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: o de se shibah fiki re otioye na e de se ode re orere na beersheba rhi te none na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Isọ vwo te ikpe ujuvẹ re, ọ da reyọ aye re se Judith rẹ ọmọ ri Beeri rẹ ohwo ri Hẹt vwọ rọvwọ, kugbe Basemath ọmọtẹ rẹ Elọn rẹ ohwo ri Hẹt,
verses.text_romanized: oke re iso vwo te ikpe ujuve re o da reyo aye re se judith re omo ri beeri re ohwo ri het vwo rovwo kugbe basemath omote re elon re ohwo ri het

verses.text_urhobo: ayen da lagha Aizik kugbe Rebeka gangan.
verses.text_romanized: ayen da lagha aizik kugbe rebeka gangan
